cohort: 103 neonates with low birth weight (<1500g) in Raichur, India
finding: An artificial neural network (ANN) model predicted invasive candidiasis with a positive predictive value (PPV) of 83.3% and a negative predictive value (NPV) of 98.7%, outperforming other existing prediction models.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery was a significant factor affecting invasive candidiasis.
